verdict.rationale: A password manager with a CLI for scripts and CI/CD could plausibly publish an interactive API reference, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only a CLI for retrieving secrets and managing vaults and items, and shows no API reference, let alone an interactive one with runnable examples. Probes for machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md docs) both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
